BiblicalUsage: Challaq means smooth, and it appears once, in Isaiah's charge against idolaters: among the smooth stones of the stream is your portion, and to them you have poured drink offerings.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe smooth stones make smooth gods, and a portion among stones is the poorest inheritance of all.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
